words.note: 當 familiarity 強調某人知道某主題的事實、資訊或基本內容時，可用 knowledge of。它比 familiarity 更直接表示『知道多少』。
words.example: Her knowledge of local history is impressive.
words.exampleZh: 她對本地歷史的知識很豐富。

exercises.original: The role requires familiarity with basic accounting principles and common financial terms.
exercises.zh: 這個職位要求了解基本會計原則和常見財務術語。
exercises.upgrade: knowledge of · 對……的知識；了解

options.explanation: friendship with = 與……的友誼。不能形容會計知識。
knowledge of = 對……的知識。principles + financial terms 明確是資訊與概念知識。
recognition of = 辨認／承認。不是知道會計內容。
exposure to = 接觸過。可能有幫助，但職位要求的是實際知道基本原則。
habit of = ……的習慣。語意不合。
intimacy with = 親密／深入熟悉。語氣過強而且搭配不自然。

exercises.original: Her familiarity with the tax rules helped her notice the mistake immediately.
exercises.zh: 她對稅務規則的了解令她立即發現錯誤。
exercises.upgrade: knowledge of · 對……的知識；了解

options.explanation: recognition of = 辨認。她是靠知道規則內容發現錯誤，不是認出某個東西。
exposure to = 接觸。只表示曾接觸過，不足以解釋立即發現規則錯誤。
acquaintance with = 略有了解。可以接近，但 notice the mistake immediately 暗示較實質知識。
friendship with = 友誼。完全不合。
knowledge of = 知識／了解。tax rules + spot mistake 是典型。
habit of = 習慣。無關。

exercises.original: A basic familiarity with geography makes the documentary easier to follow.
exercises.zh: 具備基本地理知識，會令這部紀錄片更容易理解。
exercises.upgrade: knowledge of · 對……的知識；了解

options.explanation: knowledge of = 對……的知識。basic knowledge of geography 是自然固定搭配。
recognition of = 辨認。不是辨認地名本身，而是整體地理知識。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
habit of = 習慣。無關。
intimacy with = 親密／深入熟悉。basic 與 intimacy 程度不合。
exposure to = 接觸。只說接觸過，未必真正知道內容。

words.note: 當 familiarity 表示某人對主題、人、作品或領域有一些認識，但不是深入掌握時，可用 acquaintance with。它常帶『有限、初步了解』的語感。
words.example: He has some acquaintance with classical philosophy.
words.exampleZh: 他對古典哲學略有了解。

exercises.original: The course assumes some familiarity with Shakespeare, but students do not need specialist knowledge.
exercises.zh: 課程假設學生對莎士比亞有一些認識，但不需要專門知識。
exercises.upgrade: acquaintance with · 對……略有了解；初步認識

options.explanation: expertise in = 專業知識。specialist knowledge 明確說不需要。
mastery of = 精通。程度太高。
recognition of = 辨認。不是只認得名字或作品。
acquaintance with = 略有了解。some + no specialist knowledge 是決定性線索。
command of = 熟練掌握。太強。
friendship with = 友誼。莎士比亞不是在談人際關係。

exercises.original: Her familiarity with French literature is limited to a few well-known novels.
exercises.zh: 她對法國文學的了解只限於幾本著名小說。
exercises.upgrade: acquaintance with · 對……略有了解；初步認識

options.explanation: mastery of = 精通。和 limited to a few novels 相反。
expertise in = 專業知識。太強。
acquaintance with = 略有了解。limited to a few well-known novels 非常吻合。
command of = 熟練掌握。太強。
recognition of only = 只認得。比題目更弱，因為她讀過一些小說。
intimacy with = 深入熟悉。程度過強。

exercises.original: The interviewer asked whether he had any familiarity with the region before moving there.
exercises.zh: 面試官問他搬去之前是否對該地區有任何初步認識。
exercises.upgrade: acquaintance with · 對……略有了解；初步認識

options.explanation: expertise in = 專業知識。對地區的初步認識不需要專家程度。
friendship with = 友誼。地區不是人。
recognition of = 認出。不是只辨認位置或名字。
mastery of = 精通。搭配和程度都不合。
command of = 熟練掌握。通常用於語言、技能、知識領域。
acquaintance with = 初步認識。any familiarity before moving there 最自然。

words.note: 當 familiarity 指看到、聽到某個人、地方、聲音或圖像時產生『我以前見過／聽過』的辨認感，可用 recognition。它不等於一般知識。
words.example: A look of recognition crossed her face when she heard the name.
words.exampleZh: 她聽到那個名字時，臉上露出認出的神情。

exercises.original: The old melody gave him a sudden sense of familiarity, although he could not remember where he had heard it.
exercises.zh: 那段舊旋律令他突然有熟悉感，雖然記不起在哪裡聽過。
exercises.upgrade: recognition · 辨認；認出來的熟悉感

options.explanation: friendship = 友誼。無關。
expertise = 專業知識。不是音樂專業能力。
knowledge = 知識。題目不是知道旋律資訊。
mastery = 精通。無關。
recognition = 認出來的熟悉感。heard it before but cannot place it 是典型。
experience = 經驗。太廣，不能表達突然『認得』。

exercises.original: Her face showed familiarity when the speaker mentioned the village name.
exercises.zh: 講者提到村名時，她臉上露出認得的神情。
exercises.upgrade: recognition · 辨認；認出來的熟悉感

options.explanation: knowledge = 知識。face showed knowledge 不自然。
recognition = 認出。face showed recognition 是固定而自然的說法。
expertise = 專業。無法形容臉部反應。
understanding = 理解。可以 show understanding，但村名線索是認出。
experience = 經驗。face showed experience 語意不同。
awareness = 意識。沒有『以前見過』的語感。

exercises.original: The logo created an immediate feeling of familiarity among long-time customers.
exercises.zh: 這個標誌令長期顧客立即產生辨認出的熟悉感。
exercises.upgrade: recognition · 辨認；認出來的熟悉感

options.explanation: recognition = 辨認熟悉感。logo + long-time customers + immediate 是典型。
awareness = 知道存在。較弱，沒有『一眼認出』的感覺。
knowledge = 知識。不是資訊內容。
expertise = 專業知識。顧客不是因專業而有反應。
mastery = 精通。無關。
command = 熟練掌握。無關。

words.note: 當 familiarity 只是表示知道某個問題、規則、事件或概念存在，而不一定深入了解時，可用 awareness of。它通常比 knowledge of 更淺。
words.example: Staff need awareness of the main safety risks.
words.exampleZh: 員工需要知道主要安全風險的存在。

exercises.original: The survey measured people's familiarity with the new law, including whether they had even heard of it.
exercises.zh: 調查量度人們對新法例的認識，包括是否曾經聽過它。
exercises.upgrade: awareness of · 知道……的存在；有所察覺

options.explanation: mastery of = 精通。只是 heard of it，程度遠遠不足。
expertise in = 專業知識。太強。
awareness of = 知道存在。whether they had even heard of it 是直接定義。
command of = 熟練掌握。太強。
experience with = 實際使用／接觸經驗。未必有。
intimacy with = 深入熟悉。程度相反。

exercises.original: The training is designed to increase familiarity with common cybersecurity threats among non-technical staff.
exercises.zh: 培訓旨在提高非技術員工對常見網絡安全威脅的認知。
exercises.upgrade: awareness of · 知道……的存在；有所察覺

options.explanation: expertise in = 專業知識。non-technical staff 並非要成為專家。
recognition only = 只辨認。範圍比 awareness 更窄。
mastery of = 精通。太強。
command of = 熟練掌握。太強。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
awareness of = 認知／知道存在。安全培訓常見搭配是 raise awareness of threats。

exercises.original: Before the campaign, there was very little familiarity with the condition outside specialist circles.
exercises.zh: 宣傳活動之前，專業圈以外幾乎沒有人知道這種情況。
exercises.upgrade: awareness of · 知道……的存在；有所察覺

options.explanation: experience with = 實際經驗。不是大眾認知程度。
mastery of = 精通。完全太強。
knowledge in depth = 深入知識。題目只說很少人知道。
awareness of = 對……有所認知。campaign + outside specialist circles 是典型公共認知語境。
command of = 熟練掌握。無關。
expertise in = 專業知識。恰好只存在於 specialist circles。

words.meaning: 使用／處理……的經驗；實際接觸經驗
words.note: 當 familiarity 來自實際做過、用過或處理過某事，而不是只讀過資料時，可用 experience with。它強調 hands-on contact。
words.example: Applicants should have experience with spreadsheet software.
words.exampleZh: 申請人應具備使用試算表軟件的經驗。

exercises.original: The job requires familiarity with customer-support software gained through regular use.
exercises.zh: 這份工作要求具備經常使用客戶支援軟件所得的實際經驗。
exercises.upgrade: experience with · 使用／處理……的經驗；實際接觸經驗

options.explanation: knowledge of only = 只知道相關知識。regular use 明確要求實際使用。
experience with = 使用經驗。gained through regular use 是直接線索。
recognition of = 辨認。不是使用能力。
awareness of = 知道存在。太淺。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
theory of = 理論。和 hands-on use 不同。

exercises.original: Her familiarity with difficult clients comes from ten years of front-line service work.
exercises.zh: 她處理難搞客戶的經驗來自十年第一線服務工作。
exercises.upgrade: experience with · 使用／處理……的經驗；實際接觸經驗

options.explanation: experience with = 實際經驗。ten years of front-line work 是最明確線索。
recognition of = 辨認。不是處理經驗。
awareness of = 知道存在。十年實務遠超 awareness。
acquaintance with = 略有了解。程度太弱。
friendship with = 友誼。語意錯。
memory of = 對……的記憶。不是專業經驗。

exercises.original: The technician's familiarity with this model comes from repairing hundreds of them.
exercises.zh: 技術員對這個型號的熟悉來自曾維修數百部。
exercises.upgrade: experience with · 使用／處理……的經驗；實際接觸經驗

options.explanation: friendship with = 友誼。無關。
awareness of = 知道存在。太淺。
recognition of = 認得型號。不能解釋維修能力。
acquaintance with = 略有了解。太弱。
experience with = 實際經驗。repairing hundreds 是極強 hands-on 線索。
assumption about = 對……的假設。不是實務經驗。

words.note: 當 familiarity 不只是知道事實，而是理解某事如何運作、為何如此或各部分之間的關係時，可用 understanding of。
words.example: The course develops a deeper understanding of how markets work.
words.exampleZh: 這門課加深學生對市場運作方式的理解。

exercises.original: The exam tests familiarity with how the legal system works, not just memorisation of terms.
exercises.zh: 考試測試的是對法律制度如何運作的理解，而不只是背術語。
exercises.upgrade: understanding of · 對……的理解；掌握其原理

options.explanation: recognition of = 辨認。太淺。
awareness of = 知道存在。太淺。
memory of = 記憶。題目明確說 not just memorisation。
knowledge of terms only = 只知道術語。原句正是否定這點。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
understanding of = 理解。how the system works 是直接線索。

exercises.original: Her familiarity with the machine includes knowing why each safety step is necessary.
exercises.zh: 她對機器的熟悉包括理解每個安全步驟為何必要。
exercises.upgrade: understanding of · 對……的理解；掌握其原理

options.explanation: awareness of = 知道存在。太淺。
recognition of = 辨認。太淺。
understanding of = 理解。knowing why each step is necessary 是典型原理理解。
acquaintance with = 略有了解。不能充分表達 why。
memory of = 記憶。不是機制理解。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。

exercises.original: The workshop aims to build familiarity with why certain communication strategies succeed or fail.
exercises.zh: 工作坊旨在建立對某些溝通策略為何成功或失敗的理解。
exercises.upgrade: understanding · 對……的理解；掌握其原理

options.explanation: recognition = 辨認。不能表達 why。
awareness = 認知。只是知道存在。
acquaintance = 略有了解。較弱。
understanding = 理解。why strategies succeed or fail 是決定性線索。
habit = 習慣。無關。
friendship = 友誼。無關。

words.note: 當 familiarity 主要來自曾經看過、聽過、使用過或處於某種環境中，可用 exposure to。它只保證『接觸過』，不保證深入理解或熟練。
words.example: Early exposure to different accents can improve listening skills.
words.exampleZh: 早期接觸不同口音可以改善聆聽能力。

exercises.original: Her familiarity with different accents came from growing up in a multilingual neighbourhood.
exercises.zh: 她對不同口音的熟悉，來自在多語社區成長時的長期接觸。
exercises.upgrade: exposure to · 接觸；接觸經驗

options.explanation: exposure to = 接觸。growing up in a multilingual neighbourhood 是長期接觸來源。
mastery of = 精通。聽過很多口音不等於精通。
command of = 熟練掌握。通常指語言能力，不是接觸口音。
expertise in = 專業知識。太強。
recognition only = 只辨認。題目講長期環境接觸。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。

exercises.original: Students gain familiarity with laboratory equipment by seeing and handling it during demonstrations.
exercises.zh: 學生透過示範期間看和接觸實驗室設備，建立初步熟悉感。
exercises.upgrade: exposure to · 接觸；接觸經驗

options.explanation: mastery of = 精通。示範接觸不足以達到 mastery。
command of = 熟練掌握。程度太高。
expertise in = 專業知識。程度太高。
recognition of = 辨認。只涵蓋看得出來，不包括 handling。
exposure to = 接觸。seeing and handling during demonstrations 是典型。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。

exercises.original: Regular travel gave him familiarity with several regional cuisines without making him an expert.
exercises.zh: 經常旅行令他接觸多種地區菜系，但並沒有令他成為專家。
exercises.upgrade: exposure to · 接觸；接觸經驗

options.explanation: mastery of = 精通。without making him an expert 明確排除。
exposure to = 接觸。regular travel + not expert 是非常典型。
expertise in = 專業。明確排除。
command of = 熟練掌握。太強。
intimacy with = 深入熟悉。也太強。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。

words.meaning: 足以實際工作的基本知識；實用程度的了解
words.note: 當 familiarity 表示某人不一定是專家，但已有足夠知識可以實際工作、操作或處理日常任務，可用 working knowledge of。
words.example: The role requires a working knowledge of spreadsheet formulas.
words.exampleZh: 這個職位要求具備足以實際工作的試算表公式知識。

exercises.original: Applicants need familiarity with Excel that is good enough to build and edit basic spreadsheets independently.
exercises.zh: 申請人需要對 Excel 有足夠實際工作的了解，可以獨立建立和修改基本試算表。
exercises.upgrade: working knowledge of · 足以實際工作的基本知識；實用程度的了解

options.explanation: expert mastery of = 專家級精通。basic spreadsheets 並不要求專家程度。
recognition of = 認得 Excel。太淺。
awareness of = 知道 Excel 存在。太淺。
working knowledge of = 實用程度知識。能獨立完成 basic tasks 是直接定義。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
memory of = 記憶。無關操作能力。

exercises.original: The technician needs familiarity with electrical diagrams sufficient to trace ordinary faults.
exercises.zh: 技術員需要有足夠實際工作的電路圖知識，能追查一般故障。
exercises.upgrade: working knowledge of · 足以實際工作的基本知識；實用程度的了解

options.explanation: assumption about = 假設。無關。
awareness of = 知道存在。太淺。
recognition of = 辨認圖表。不能保證能追查故障。
expertise far beyond the role = 遠超職位的專業。題目只要求 ordinary faults。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
working knowledge of = 實用程度知識。sufficient to trace ordinary faults 是最直接線索。

exercises.original: A basic familiarity with HTML is enough for this role as long as you can make simple page edits.
exercises.zh: 這個職位只要有足以作簡單頁面修改的 HTML 基本實用知識就可以。
exercises.upgrade: working knowledge of · 足以實際工作的基本知識；實用程度的了解

options.explanation: recognition of = 認得 HTML。不能保證會修改頁面。
mastery of = 精通。太強。
working knowledge of = 實用程度知識。simple page edits + enough for role 是典型。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
awareness only = 只知道存在。太淺。
expertise in = 專業知識。比職位要求高。

words.note: conversance with 是較正式、書面的說法，表示對某個專門領域、文獻、法律、技術或程序相當熟悉。它比 acquaintance with 深，但通常不像 mastery 那樣表示完全精通。
words.example: The role requires conversance with current data-protection law.
words.exampleZh: 這個職位要求熟悉現行資料保護法律。

exercises.original: Senior counsel are expected to have strong familiarity with the relevant case law and recent judgments.
exercises.zh: 資深法律顧問應相當熟悉相關案例法和近期判決。
exercises.upgrade: conversance with · 對……相當熟悉；熟知（正式）

options.explanation: recognition of = 辨認。遠不足以處理 case law。
awareness of = 知道存在。太淺。
exposure to only = 只接觸過。太弱。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
conversance with = 熟知。senior counsel + relevant case law 是典型正式專業語境。
habit of = 習慣。無關。

exercises.original: The researcher demonstrated deep familiarity with the literature on early language development.
exercises.zh: 研究員顯示出對早期語言發展文獻相當熟悉。
exercises.upgrade: conversance with · 對……相當熟悉；熟知（正式）

options.explanation: conversance with = 熟知。researcher + literature + deep familiarity 是很自然的正式用法。
awareness only = 只知道存在。太弱。
recognition = 辨認。不是熟悉文獻內容。
mastery beyond question = 毫無疑問的完全精通。比原句更強。
friendship = 友誼。無關。
casual exposure = 隨意接觸。程度太弱。

exercises.original: The post requires familiarity with international reporting standards and their recent amendments.
exercises.zh: 這個職位要求熟悉國際報告準則及其近期修訂。
exercises.upgrade: conversance with · 對……相當熟悉；熟知（正式）

options.explanation: awareness of = 知道存在。對職位要求太淺。
conversance with = 熟知。formal post + technical standards + recent amendments 是典型。
recognition of = 辨認。不能表示熟知準則。
friendship with = 友誼。無關。
memory of = 記憶。不是專業熟悉程度。
habit of = 習慣。無關。

falseSynonyms.zh: 專業知識；專長不等於一般的 familiarity expertise 表示較高程度的專業能力，通常比 familiarity 強得多。你可以 familiar with a topic，但遠未成為 expert。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Familiarity can be basic; expertise is advanced professional knowledge.

falseSynonyms.zh: 精通；完全掌握不等於一般的 familiarity mastery 表示高度熟練和控制能力，是 familiarity 的強化很多倍，不是一般同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Familiarity does not imply mastery.

falseSynonyms.zh: 熟練掌握不等於一般的 familiarity command 常見於 a good command of English 等，表示能熟練運用；單純 familiarity 未必足以實際熟練運用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Command implies strong practical control.

falseSynonyms.zh: 友誼不等於一般的 familiarity familiarity 有時也可指人際上的熟絡，但 friendship 是實際友誼關係，不等於『熟悉程度』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Familiarity with a person does not automatically mean friendship.

falseSynonyms.zh: 親密；非常深入的熟悉不等於一般的 familiarity intimacy 比一般 familiarity 更深、更私人，也可有親密關係含義，因此不能作中性通用替換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Intimacy is deeper and more personal than ordinary familiarity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 記憶不等於一般的 familiarity memory 是記住某事的能力或內容；熟悉感可能來自記憶，但 familiarity 本身不是 memory。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Memory can create familiarity, but the concepts differ.

falseSynonyms.zh: 習慣不等於一般的 familiarity habit 是反覆形成的行為模式；熟悉某事不等於把它變成習慣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A habit is repeated behaviour; familiarity is a degree of knowing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可辨認的不等於一般的 familiarity recognisable 是形容詞，表示某物容易被認出；familiarity 是名詞，表示熟悉、了解或辨認感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Recognisable describes something; familiarity names a state of knowing.
